# Supabase remote MCP API

Client Libraries

### Streamable HTTP endpoint (POST)

​

This endpoint allows clients to connect to the Supabase MCP server using [Streamable HTTP transport](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/transports/streamable-http). It serves two protocol revisions on the same URL, selected by the client:

- 2025-era clients use the [Streamable HTTP transport](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-06-18/basic/transports#streamable-http) and receive an `Mcp-Session-Id` on initialization.
- Clients that negotiate `2026-07-28` are served per request and are neither issued nor asked for an `Mcp-Session-Id`. These requests must carry the `Mcp-Method` header (plus `Mcp-Name` for a tool call).
Both revisions operate statelessly, so only POST is supported, and a POST whose media type is not `application/json` is rejected with 415.

Note that you would normally use an MCP client to connect to this endpoint rather than calling it directly.

#### Query Parameters

- project_ref

Type: string
min length:

 20
max length:

 20

The project reference to scope the MCP server to. If not provided, the server will have access to all projects in your Supabase account.
- read_only

Type: string

Indicates whether or not the MCP server should operate in read-only mode. This prevents write operations on any of your databases by executing SQL as a read-only Postgres user.
- features

Type: string

A comma-separated list of feature groups to filter tools by. If not provided, a default set of feature groups is enabled. Some groups (such as `storage`) are opt-in and are only enabled when explicitly included here.

The following feature groups are supported: `docs`, `account`, `database`, `debugging`, `development`, `functions`, `branching`, `storage`, `notebooks`.
- skip_elicitations

Type: string

A comma-separated list of elicitation-capable tools that should use the legacy confirmation flow instead of MCP elicitation.

The following elicitation tools are supported: `create_project`, `create_branch`, `execute_sql`, `apply_migration`.

#### Headers

- Accept

enum
const:

application/json, text/event-stream

required

Accepted response content types
- MCP-Protocol-Version

Type: "2025-06-18" or "2026-07-28"enum
required

MCP protocol version being used

#### Responses

- application/json
- 202

Accepted (for notifications and responses)
- application/json
- 415

Unsupported media type, Content-Type must be application/json

Request Example for post/mcp

```javascript
fetch('/mcp?project_ref=abcdefghijklmnopqrst', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    Accept: 'application/json, text/event-stream',
    'MCP-Protocol-Version': '2025-06-18',
    Authorization: 'Bearer YOUR_SECRET_TOKEN'
  }
})
```

### Streamable HTTP endpoint (GET)

​

Supabase MCP operates in stateless mode, so does not support the GET method. The GET method is designed for server-to-client streaming using Server-Sent Events (SSE).

All GET requests to this endpoint will be rejected with a 405 Method Not Allowed response as required by the MCP specification.

#### Responses

- Method not allowed, only POST is supported

Request Example for get/mcp

No Body
